title: Subtle list element deletion during iteration
diff:
@@ -3,4 +3,6 @@
 def remove_expired_tokens(active_tokens: list[dict]) -> None:
     """Remove stale sessions directly from the active token list."""
     now = time.time()
-    active_tokens[:] = [t for t in active_tokens if t["expires_at"] > now]
+    for token in active_tokens:
+        if token["expires_at"] <= now:
+            active_tokens.remove(token)

ground_truth.description: Mutating list while iterating over it causes element skipping due to index shifts.
